questions.topic: PrepLadder · 2.Basics of MRI and Interventional Radiology
questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient is scheduled for an MRI of the brain to assess potential lesions. Which of the following best describes the fundamental principle of MRI?

options.label: A
options.text: Evaluate changes in magnetic field strength around tissues

options.label: B
options.text: Alignment and relaxation of hydrogen nuclei

options.label: C
options.text: Detection of thermal radiation emitted by tissues.

options.label: D
options.text: Measurement of varying ionizing radiation absorption.
